title: Beach Tee 30A
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Watersound is a Gated Community with deeded beach access, community pools, and restaurants - Private Pool - Rooftop Terrace w/ Panoramic Views - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bikes Included Located within the exclusive community of WaterSound Beach, Beach Tee 30A is a luxurious coastal retreat offering Gulf views, exceptional privacy, and direct access to the natural beauty of Deer Lake State Park. With over 5,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this six-bedroom, six-and-a-half-bath home is ideal for families and groups seeking an elevated 30A getaway. The main living level is designed for gathering and entertaining, featuring a chef’s kitchen with premium Thermador appliances, dual dishwashers and sinks, and an oversized island that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. Just outside, guests can enjoy a private outdoor oasis complete with a heated pool, in-ground hot tub, travertine pool deck, and outdoor kitchen for effortless indoor-outdoor living. The second-floor primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a private porch overlooking the preserved landscape, while additional en-suite bedrooms and convenient laundry access add comfort and functionality. Upstairs, a secondary living area, bunk room, and rooftop terrace provide even more space to relax, with panoramic views of the Gulf and surrounding dunes. A detached carriage house includes its own bedroom, full bath, kitchenette, and garage space, offering added privacy for guests. The home also features ample parking and easy access to Watersound Beach’s private beach entrance, resort-style amenities, fitness center, and nearby favorites like The Big Chill 30A. Beach Tea 30A combines luxury, space, and natural beauty in one of 30A’s most sought-after beach communities. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower only - Half Bathroom Second Floor - Master King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower only - Queen Bedroom, Private Bathroom w/ Shower/Tub Combo Third Floor - Bedroom w/ Three Twin Beds and Window Day Bed, Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Carriage House - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom
